title: GTA 6 Devs Avoided Passing Trends to Create Their Own Style
description: Discover how GTA 6 developers avoided jumping on passing trends during their long development cycle, opting to create their own exaggerated versions instead.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Development Philosophy: Avoiding Passing Trends

Crafting timely satire is notoriously difficult when a game's development cycle spans half a decade or more. While long-running animated shows like South Park can stick with a crude art style to quickly react to current events, the developers of GTA 6 cannot simply replace world-class technology with paper cutouts. According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Eurogamer, the team behind Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster took a different approach: they tried hard not to jump on the bandwagon of passing trends, choosing instead to create their own "slanted, overblown versions."

### The Reality of Long Development Cycles

As the gaming industry continues to push the boundaries of graphical fidelity and technical scope, the time required to build massive open-world titles has grown exponentially. For a project as anticipated as GTA 6, a multi-year development timeline means that many contemporary internet trends, fleeting memes, and pop culture fads will inevitably become outdated by the time players actually get their hands on the final product. 

### Bypassing Outdated Content

Faced with this logistical challenge, the development team reportedly made a conscious effort to steer clear of trends that risk losing relevance upon launch. By avoiding the temptation to chase every short-lived viral moment, the team helps ensure that the satirical world of GTA 6 remains impactful and cohesive, rather than feeling like a dated collection of yesterday's internet culture.

### Embracing an Overblown Aesthetic

Instead of chasing fast-moving fads, the creators leaned into what the GTA franchise has always done best: crafting their own exaggerated and skewed reflections of society. By developing unique, overblown versions of cultural phenomena rather than direct parodies of temporary trends, the developers aim to deliver a satirical experience that stands the test of time and resonates deeply with players.

## Editor's Take

It is refreshing to see the GTA 6 team prioritize timeless satire over cheap, short-lived pop culture references. Long development cycles are a double-edged sword, but by shaping their own exaggerated mirror of society, Rockstar continues to prove its mastery in world-building and cultural commentary.
